label: Tripp Lite PDUMH30NET switched PDU 30A 120V (16x5-20R, 2U)
description: 2U horizontal switched PDU for 120 V single-phase feeds: NEMA L5-30P input derated to 24 A continuous, 16 individually switchable NEMA 5-15/20R outlets in two 20 A breakered load banks, 2.9 kW. A pre-installed LX Platform (WEBCARDLX) card provides one 10/100BASE-T RJ45 running the HTML5 web UI, telnet/SSH, SNMP v1/v2/v3 and DHCP/BOOTP.
notes: Vendor spec sheet 'Network Monitoring Port: RJ45 Network port, Micro-USB Configuration port, USB A port supports a variety of Envirosense2 environmental and control modules' and 'Network Compatibility: 10 Mbps; 100 Mbps (Fast Ethernet)'; protocols listed include IPv4/IPv6, HTTP, HTTPS, SMTP, SNMPv1/v2/v3, telnet, SSH, FTP, DHCP, BOOTP and NTP - hence dhcp-client. The USB-A port takes EnviroSense2 sensor/control modules and the Micro-USB port is a local configuration console, so neither is a network interface. Tripp Lite is now the Eaton Tripp Lite series; the TAA version is PDUMH30NETAA.
